analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 판독 유지. RSI 40선 중반 횡보, MACD 히스토그램은 음수권에서 악화 지속. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 0.73으로 위축된 움직임. 변동성 ATR 2.41% 대비 스윙 지지선 330.20까지의 하락 리스크는 3.5% 수준으로, 현재가 $342.48 대비 1.5 ATR 거리. 매수 진입은 RSI 50 이상 회복 및 MACD 개선 확인 후 고려.
analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 consecutive trading days. RSI is hovering in the mid-40s, and the MACD histogram continues to worsen in negative territory. The volume ratio relative to the 5-day average is 0.73, indicating subdued activity. The downside risk to the swing support at $330.20, relative to the ATR of 2.41%, is approximately 3.5%, or 1.5 ATR distance from the current price of $342.48. A buy entry will be considered after confirming RSI recovery above 50 and MACD improvement.
